reference_sql:
SELECT c.channel_id,
       percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.impressions) AS p25_impressions,
       percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.impressions) AS p75_impressions
FROM ad_spend_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
GROUP BY c.channel_id
alternatives:

       quantile_cont(a.impressions, 0.25) OVER (PARTITION BY c.channel_id) AS p25_impressions,
       quantile_cont(a.impressions, 0.75) OVER (PARTITION BY c.channel_id) AS p75_impressions
FROM ad_spend_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'

other_way.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.channel_id,
       quantile_cont(a.impressions, 0.25) OVER (PARTITION BY c.channel_id) AS p25_impressions,
       quantile_cont(a.impressions, 0.75) OVER (PARTITION BY c.channel_id) AS p75_impressions
FROM ad_spend_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
other_way.tradeoff: quantile_cont over a window puts the same cut points on every row, so it needs DISTINCT to give one row per channel.

solver.query:
SELECT c.channel_id,
       QUANTILE_CONT(s.impressions, 0.25) AS p25_impressions,
       QUANTILE_CONT(s.impressions, 0.75) AS p75_impressions
FROM ad_spend_daily s
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = s.campaign_id
WHERE s.spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND s.spend_date <= DATE '2025-10-31'
GROUP BY c.channel_id
